full_judgment: 13. We have also perused the letter of dismissal dated 30.01.2002 (Annexure-Q to the writ petition) wherefrom it appears that the Writ Petition No. 20 of 1999 filed by the respondent was disposed of on 27.01.2002 and the letter of dismissal (Annexure-Q to the writ petition) appears to have been issued on 30.01.2002. We are surprised to find unusual speed in which the petitioners moved to effect the dismissal of the respondent. Moreso on perusal of the impugned judgment it appears that the High Court Division considered thoroughly the report of the committee holding inquiry into allegation of interpolation in the Indents in question who could not fix up the responsibility of any individual person and as such the High Court Division took the view correctly that under such circumstances the order of dismissal of the respondent has been illegal.
